notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
This weeks update brings some additional content for level 1. There is now a memory and a key to find. When the memory isn't found, you can come back to the level to search again. We've also made various bug fixes and QOL improvements you can see listed below. As always, let us know what you are thinking of the game so far and what you would like to see implemented by commenting on this post or in our discord. 


 Added Memory to level 1
 Added another scare
 Added key to escape level 1
 Lowered volume of thunder
 Added link to main menu to learn about PTSD
 Replaced doors in level 1 house with regular interior doors


- Mad Scientist Studios

notes.title: New Beta Release!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34301985/1f9b1edc76ddd9dae567faa4641cf73ce7b58f2b.pngHello there! Your favorite dev Hunter here yet again, how is everyone enjoying the new beta?? The team was super excited to get this pushed out to you and we really hope your enjoying it. We also recognize that there isn't a ton of content right now and wanted to let you know to not be worried! We are working our asses off to get more updates out to you guys. Think of this like a small little taste, the big reward is coming soon! Also if you are enjoying the beta and want to let us know what you think, be sure to head over to the #the-river-bugs-and-feedback chat in our discord and tell us! You can also comment on this post here, we check all of our platforms often. Also if you find any glitches or bugs be sure to post them in there so we can knock em out. Thank you for your time and can't wait to hear from you all :) 
- Hunter, Lead Level Designer
